title: 'The Beautiful Home' 1/2 Mi to Old Hickory Lake!
description:
1 Mi to Picnic Pavilions & Boat Launch | Dedicated Workspace | Day Trip to Nashville

Step away from the everyday and settle into relaxed lake-town living at this Mt. Juliet vacation rental! Designed for families and small groups, the modern house delivers the space and comfort needed for a laid-back escape near the water. Launch a boat on Old Hickory Lake or picnic at Lone Branch Access Area before heading home to unwind on the deck and watch the sunset. It’s the reset you deserve — book now!

The space
OUTDOOR LIVING
- Private back deck w/ dining set 
- Lake views (winter months only)

INDOOR LIVING
- Flat-screen TV
- Dining table
- Dedicated workspace w/ printer (bedroom 3)
- Walk-in shower, shower/tub combo
- Washer & dryer 

KITCHEN
- Stove/oven, refrigerator, dishwasher
- Cooking basics, dishware/flatware 
- Pod coffee maker (Keurig, coffee provided)
- Microwave, toaster, ice maker, spices 

ACCESSIBILITY
- Single-story home, 2 steps to enter

PARKING
- Driveway (2 vehicles)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property

Other things to note
- No smoking 
- No pets allowed 
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- This single-story home requires 2 steps to enter
- The lake is only visible during the winter months

SECURITY CAMERA INFORMATION
- 2 exterior devices
- Location: front of house 
- Coverage: entry, driveway
